* Living Lightning : No longer replaces minions when summoning a new one while already at maximum number of minions. * Fixed a bug where Living Lightning II did not scale its level from the Gem it was Supporting.
* Fixed a bug where Living Lightning couldn't be triggered from a different weapon set than the skill performed with it.

- Living Lightning's living lightnings' Attacks now deal the same amount of damage for each Hit in the Chain (previously erroneously dealing less damage per subsequent Hit in the Chain). - Living Lightning II now has a Cooldown count of 8 (previously 5). - Fixed an issue preventing Living Lightning Support from being able to be Supported by certain gems.
* Fixed a bug where Triggered Living Lightning did not having the Cooldown type, which prevented supportability for Cooldown Recovery Support.
* Fixed a bug where Living Lightning Support was not triggering correctly after the explosion of a Poison Cloud.
